<?php
class PeerBase201 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $owner; $owner = null; echo 'MAGIC;'; return static function () use ($arguments, $name) { echo 'CLOSURE:', self::secret(), ':', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return new class($arguments, $name) { public function __construct(public array $saved, public string $name) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived201 extends PeerBase201 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived201; $factory = $owner->MiSsInG(first: "BYTE\x80", later: 1.5); echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'HELD;'; $child = $factory(); unset($factory); echo $child->saved['first'], ':', $child->saved['later'] === 1.5 ? 'FLOAT' : 'BAD', ':', $child->name, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
